text:
sam.marketing: Heads-up for launch comms: need a rigorous rerun of the benchmark we plan to cite. Goal: defensible p50/p95/p99 and a clear note on methodology for the blog + webinar. cc @noah.runtime @tess.eng

noah.runtime: OK. What exact config and artifacts do you need?

sam.marketing: Deliverables: 1) CSV table with p50/p95/p99 for both quantized candidate and fp16 baseline, 2) estimated cost per 1M tokens, 3) coldstart heatmap PNG, 4) 25 anonymized raw traces, 5) a short runbook TXT describing sampling, warmup, and seeding. Please include per-slice percentiles (short, interactive, long-tail).

tess.eng: We'll need model + tokenizer + quant name + seed + cohort size + whether cache should be enabled. Also confirm whether dynamic batching should be forced off to isolate per-token latency.

sam.marketing: Model: redwood-alpha-8k@rev17. Tokenizer: rwd-tokenizer-v5. Quant: q4_3a-experimental. Seed: 314159. Cohort: N=100 for overall stability, but we accept a prioritized N=40 pass if compute constrained. Cache: ON for the primary run to reflect production; include a separate coldstart slice with cache=OFF and --warmup 0 (10 samples). Batching: keep dynamic batching=auto for the main run, but include a forced-batching=off slice to show single-request latency.

meg.metrics: Quick methodological ask: please include bootstrap CIs for p95 and an explanation of how you compute cost/token (which price table). We'll need those details for the blog to avoid misinterpretation.

noah.runtime: Plan: run cohort=100 variants="q4_3a-experimental,fp16" context=8192 tokenizer=rwd-tokenizer-v5 seed=314159 batching=auto cache=on tags=marketing,launch. Then run two short slices: (A) cache=off --warmup 0 N=10; (B) batching=off N=20. We'll compute bootstrap CIs and cost using the standard price table (internal-pricing-2026).

noah.runtime: Command we'll enqueue:
```
enqueue-bench --cohort launch100 --seed 314159 --model redwood-alpha-8k@rev17 --tokenizer rwd-tokenizer-v5 --variants "q4_3a-experimental,fp16" --context 8192 --batching auto --cache on --tags marketing,embargoed,priority
```

ci-bot: :white_check_mark: Job queued: #3602 by noah.runtime  status: pending (https://rundashboard/jobs/3602)

noah.runtime: ETA start ~08:00 UTC tomorrow; estimated runtime 4-6h. If queue spikes we'll run a prioritized N=40 pass to give you conservative percentiles and heatmap for rehearsal, then backfill full traces later.

sam.marketing: Two more asks: 1) include the run config JSON and a reproducibility note that lists exact runner warmup defaults and host counts, 2) scrub traces of any IDs and replace with stable pseudonyms. We'll embargo artifacts until launch.

tess.eng: We'll include run_config.json, an annotations.txt describing slices, and run-level metadata that shows warmup counts per host. We'll also tag each trace with a pseudonym map file.

meg.metrics: I'll review the outputs and sanity-check the cost calculations. If any p95 CI overlaps heavily with baseline, we'll flag that in the blog copy and recommend conservative wording.

noah.runtime: Noted. We'll upload artifacts to /share/marketing/bench-artifacts/1729012345/ and ping this thread. If anything blocks the full run, we'll provide a short smoke report with p50/p95 and a PNG heatmap within 2h of starting.

sam.marketing: Thank you. Please tag me when artifacts are uploaded - rehearsal is tight. Also leave a short one-paragraph method blurb we can paste into the blog footnotes. :v
